ModMetaData.name: RimScent Extended: Weather Expansion
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
The air outside, and the ground it sits on. Weather, disasters, water, forest.
THE GROUND ITSELF — NEW GROUND FOR RIMSCENT RimScent reads only things standing on a tile. Terrain is not a thing: water, mud, sand and ice have no ThingDef, so nothing that gives a place its smell was reachable at all. RimScent Extended adds ModExtension_TerrainScent for exactly this, and the scan reads the terrain grid on the tiles it already walks — an indexed lookup, no extra cost.
- Fresh water: cool water and wet stone, and it carries a long way. - The sea: salt, iodine and cold open water. - Stagnant water — warm mud, sulphurous and sweetish — but ONLY above 18C. It is the temperature that makes a marsh smell, not the marsh. Below the threshold the tile does not count at all. - Hot springs and the steam geyser: warm mineral steam, faintly of sulphur and iron. - Toxic water and lava (Odyssey) reuse RimScent's own toxic and ash thoughts.
Terrain is counted PER TILE, unlike weather. Three tiles of water at the edge of a stream do not smell like a marsh stretching to the horizon, and the thought's stack limit caps the total — so the number of tiles becomes a free measure of how much of it is around you.
THE FOREST Every tree, through the plant/treeCategory marker the game already uses to tell a tree from a plant — not a hand-written list. A mod that declares its own tree parent is caught by the same xpath without being named. The six special trees are excluded: anima and gauranlen have a presence of their own, Anomaly's harbinger tree is a horror, and the bonsai is furniture.
WEATHER AND CONDITIONS RimScent already covers rain, fog, toxic fallout and volcanic winter. This adds what it left out, across the base game and all four DLC:
- Dry thunderstorm and flashstorm: ozone, the smell of a storm that has not broken yet. - Snow, blizzard, cold snap, deep freeze: the cold has taken everything out of the air, and that is a relief. - Heat wave, unnatural heat, heat vents: everything comes back up at once. - Bioluminescent spores, drought (Odyssey). - Torrential rain smells of petrichor, blood rain of blood, the gray pall of gray flesh, noxious haze of toxins, volcanic ash of ash — all reusing RimScent's own thoughts by name rather than adding new ones. The pyromaniac is unaffected by ash, as upstream. - Vanilla Events Expanded: drought, swelter, psychic bloom.
No MayRequire anywhere: a conditional patch whose xpath matches nothing does nothing, so DLC defs are targeted directly and the mod works without them.
WHAT IS NOT IN IT Pheromones. RimScent reads a neighbour's hediffs, and no vanilla hediff marks them — a scent on every human would simply be permanent. Unwashed colonists are already covered by RimScent itself, through its Dubs Bad Hygiene support.
Ships in English with a French translation injected on top. No save data.
Requires RimScent and RimScent Extended.
